description: This file defines functions related to safe string formatting, specifically a custom implementation of snprintf (git_snprintf) and its supporting internal function (git_vsnprintf). It handles platform-specific buffer correction and resizing logic for string formatting operations.

methods.name: int git_vsnprintf(char * str,size_t maxsize,const char * format,va_list ap)
methods.description: A custom version of vsnprintf that handles buffer sizing, platform-specific issues, and resizing loops for safe string formatting.

methods.name: int git_snprintf(char * str,size_t maxsize,const char * format,...)
methods.description: A wrapper around git_vsnprintf that initializes variadic argument processing and returns the formatted string length.
